digest.component_or_area: Test suite - JIRA DC transport and pagination
propositions: Five existing tests contain assertions that cannot fail because they test vacuous conditions, tautologies, or re-implement predicates inline instead of calling shared helpers
test_the_pat_never_appears_in_the_repr_of_the_transport constructs a transport with no credential, making the assertion against the literal PAT string unreachable

test_the_structural_guard_fires_on_a_synthetic_unpaginated_caller re-implements the AST walk inline instead of calling _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default(), so the test cannot fail if the actual predicate regresses
_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() hardcodes its input source and takes no parameters, blocking the teeth test from feeding a synthetic source
test_validate_assignee_exists_returns_the_dc_username only asserts hasattr(cls, 'validate_assignee_exists'), duplicating the parametrized presence test and leaving the return-value contract untested
test_every_mutating_transport_member_still_fails_on_the_first_429 asserts total <= 1 which permits zero calls, allowing members that raise pre-flight to pass without exercising the 429 retry branch
